title: Crashes on multiple programs (jvm, MoonBleedingEdge, cargo)
body: Hello, I'm quite new to Linux but not unfamiliar with Unix. Two months ago, I built my first gaming PC hoping I could run every game using proton. Well the issue isn't here, the issue is that a lot of programs are crashing to what appears to me as memory errors (I may be completely wrong). Minecraft crashes with the garbage collector, Ultrakill (MoonBleedingEdge) crashes with a wine error that let me to find other threads talking about memory bugs, and much more. I haven't ran Memtest86 yet, which I plan to do when I have time to. My config: https://pastebin.com/SkkR40bE Note: I used `archinstall` for my system. Could anyone point/help me in the right direction to solve those numerous crashes? I'm very sure they are all connected. Last edited by Marlori (2025-03-01 11:15:39)
